title: 矩阵对角线元素的和
summary: 求方阵主对角线与副对角线元素之和，中心元素若重合只计一次。
insight: 逐行加入 matrix[row][row] 与 matrix[row][n-1-row]；奇数阶中心在最后减去一次。

solutions.title: 双对角线扫描
solutions.idea: 按行读取两条对角线并修正中心重复。
steps: 若 n 为奇数，减 matrix[n/2][n/2]

code.java: class Solution { public int diagonalSum(int[][] mat){int n=mat.length,answer=0;for(int row=0;row<n;row++)answer+=mat[row][row]+mat[row][n-1-row];if(n%2==1)answer-=mat[n/2][n/2];return answer;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun diagonalSum(mat:Array<IntArray>):Int{val n=mat.size;var answer=0;for(row in 0 until n)answer+=mat[row][row]+mat[row][n-1-row];if(n%2==1)answer-=mat[n/2][n/2];return answer} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public: int diagonalSum(vector<vector<int>>& mat){int n=mat.size(),answer=0;for(int row=0;row<n;++row)answer+=mat[row][row]+mat[row][n-1-row];if(n%2)answer-=mat[n/2][n/2];return answer;} };
